SSH Config Generator

Build ~/.ssh/config Host entries — alias, hostname, user, port, identity file — with sane defaults.

Save as ~/.ssh/config and run: chmod 600 ~/.ssh/config

📖 How to use

  1. Add one host per line: "alias|hostname|user|port|identityfile".
  2. Toggle global keepalive options.
  3. The config generates live.
  4. Copy it or download as "config".

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the line format?

alias|hostname|user|port|identityfile — port and identity file are optional; empty fields fall back to SSH defaults.

Where does the file go?

Save it as ~/.ssh/config with permissions 600 (chmod 600 ~/.ssh/config).

What do the global options do?

ServerAliveInterval/ServerAliveCountMax keep idle connections from timing out.

Is my data sent anywhere?

No — everything is generated locally in your browser.
